gig_title: WSH Internal System Audit for Power Substation Contractor
short_description: Looking for a WSH specialist to run an internal audit of our safety management system. We are a small electrical services team supporting power generation sites, around 40 staff, MOM-registered as a WSH training-required contractor. The work: review our existing WSH documentation and risk assessment procedures, check them against the SS 651 requirements we committed to in our last MOM inspection, run an audit on site at our Jurong workshop and one substation project, and draft findings with corrective actions for each gap found. Most paperwork exists already, it just needs checking and tidying. Deliverable: an audit report with gap findings, corrective action list, and updated risk assessment templates. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$6,000-8,000; audit must start by early next month.

gig_title: E-Waste and Equipment Disposal Compliance Review
short_description: We are a private training provider in Singapore with three campuses and about 1,800 laptops, projectors and lab devices in circulation, several due for retirement. We need an electronics management specialist to review how we decommission and dispose of IT equipment, checking our process against NEA e-waste rules and PDPA requirements for data-bearing devices. The work covers our current disposal chain, vendor practices and data sanitisation steps, with recommendations to close any gaps. Deliverable: a written assessment with a prioritised remediation roadmap and a model disposal SOP. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Supplier Sourcing Review for Hardware Procurement
short_description: Looking for a procurement specialist to review how we source IT hardware and cloud services for a 40-person SaaS company. We buy laptops, network gear and managed cloud through a messy mix of resellers, and I suspect we are overpaying and over-contracting. The task: audit our last 12 months of purchase orders and contracts, map spend by category and vendor, benchmark key prices against Singapore market rates, and sit with me to walk through the findings and where we can consolidate. Deliverable: a written sourcing review report with spend analysis, benchmarked prices and 3-5 specific consolidation recommendations. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Mystery Shopping Assessment Across Branch Counters
short_description: Looking for a specialist to run a mystery shopping exercise across our customer-facing branches. We are a mid-sized logistics and distribution company with 6 branch counters in Singapore handling walk-in freight bookings. Visit each branch at least twice as a regular customer, assess how staff handle quotations, shipment queries and complaints, and score the interactions against a simple checklist we will agree upfront. Provide an overall service rating, branch-by-branch findings, and recommendations on staff training and front-counter processes. Deliverable: a written mystery shopping report with scores, observations and prioritised recommendations per branch. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Import Shipping Compliance Review for Food Distributor
short_description: I run a small food import and distribution business, bringing in chilled and frozen goods from Malaysia, Thailand and Australia for about 40 restaurant and hawker customers. I need a maritime shipping specialist to review how our freight is booked and documented. Go through our bills of lading, cold chain handovers and forwarder arrangements, check them against MPA and SFA import requirements, and flag where we are exposed, such as unclear liability for spoiled cargo or missing permits. Then draft the corrected document templates and a short SOP our ops team can follow. Deliverable: a written findings report plus revised shipping document templates and a one-page SOP. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Process Safety Handbook Section for Pharma Plant
short_description: We run a small pharmaceutical manufacturing plant in Singapore, licensed by HSA, with about 60 staff across production, QC and packing. We need a process safety section written for our staff handbook, covering permit-to-work, hot work, chemical handling and emergency response at the plant. This is high-stakes: the wording will be referenced during our next regulatory inspection. Mixed work: draft the section in plain language, then advise us through one review round as we take it to management. Deliverable: a finished handbook section of roughly 8-12 pages, with supporting safe work procedure summaries. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: LTA Bus Operator Licence Safety Case Preparation
short_description: We are a mid-sized building and civil construction contractor with about 400 site staff across six worksites, running a private staff shuttle fleet of nine buses between dormitories and sites. We need a bus operations specialist to prepare and assemble our safety case and operations documentation for renewal under the LTA's Bus Service Operator licensing requirements. The work covers route and duty schedules, driver rostering and hours-of-service records, preventive maintenance and inspection regimes, and incident escalation procedures, then drafting the submissions in the format LTA expects. Deliverable: a completed licence renewal submission pack, including the safety case document and supporting schedules, ready to lodge with LTA. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.

gig_title: Genetic Testing Consent Pack Review
short_description: We run a small Singapore employment law practice with about 20 staff, and we are arranging genetic testing benefits for our staff health programme. We need a genetic counsellor to review and rewrite our consent forms and information sheets so they are accurate and easy for laypeople to follow, and to flag anything that conflicts with MOH guidance or the PDPA. You will advise us over one or two calls, then revise the documents yourself. Deliverable: a revised consent and information pack (4 documents) plus a short memo of key changes. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$2,500-3,500, with work starting in the first week of next month.

gig_title: Patent Portfolio Review for Precision Engineering Firm
short_description: We need an outside opinion on our patent filings before a licensing discussion. We are a precision engineering company with about 80 staff, 6 granted Singapore patents and 3 pending applications. Want an IP specialist to review each filing for scope, validity risk and commercial value, and advise which to keep, abandon or amend. Deliverable: a written memo with recommendations per patent, plus a short management briefing call. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$6,000-9,000; must be qualified to practise Singapore IP law.

gig_title: Lighting Design for Shipyard Safety Launch Event
short_description: We are a mid-sized ship repair yard on Jurong Island with about 120 staff, staging an outdoor safety launch event for 300 workers and guests in two weeks. We need a technical theatre specialist to design and run the lighting and basic AV for the evening programme: a stage, two speeches, a safety pledge ceremony and a short video screening. Deliverable: a lighting plot, an equipment list hired within our S$4,000 budget, and on-site operation of the show across one rehearsal and the event evening. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Mystery Shopper Assessment Across Garden Retail Outlets
short_description: We are a family-owned garden centre and landscaping supplies retailer in Singapore with four outlets and about 35 staff. We want an independent specialist to visit all four outlets as a regular customer over the next few weeks, assess the buying experience, product advice quality, upselling, and compliance with our PDPA obligations when collecting customer particulars for loyalty sign-ups. You will then review the findings with us and advise management on what to fix first. Deliverable: a written assessment with outlet-by-outlet scores, findings, and prioritised recommendations for management. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Succession and Talent Retention Review for Charity
short_description: A mid-sized Singapore social service charity running elder care and family programmes across four centres, with 120 staff, wants a talent management specialist to review how we identify and keep senior programme leads. The work covers mapping key roles, running staff stay interviews, and drafting a retention framework aligned to our NCSS funding requirements. Deliverable: a written report with a role map, interview findings, and a phased retention plan we can implement. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$8,000-12,000, work to start by early next quarter.

gig_title: Redesign HACCP QA Slide Deck
short_description: We need our QA training slide deck rebuilt into something clean and presentable. We are an engineering services firm, about 40 staff, and our deck covers HACCP and SFA food safety requirements for clients in food manufacturing. It currently sits at around 60 slides, text heavy, mixed fonts and dated layouts. We want a specialist to restructure it into a clear flow, cut redundant content, redo diagrams and tables, and apply one consistent template. Working files should stay in PowerPoint so our team can edit them after. Deliverable: a redesigned PowerPoint deck of about 40-50 slides, plus the source template file, handed over in editable form. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Assess and Clear Service Email Backlog
short_description: We run a small statutory board logistics support desk and our shared service inbox has a growing backlog of citizen and vendor enquiries. We need a specialist to review the queue, diagnose why items are piling up, recommend a triage method and response templates, and clear the current outstanding emails in line with our PDPA handling practices. Deliverable: a short assessment with recommendations, standard reply templates, and the inbox cleared to zero. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Independent Review of Payment App Security Posture
short_description: I run a small licensed digital payment startup in Singapore, about 20 staff, regulated by MAS under the Payment Services Act. I need an independent assessment of our mobile wallet product before a major release: review the architecture, threat model and key controls against MAS TRM guidelines and CSA Cyber Essentials, and tell us plainly where the gaps are. Deliverable: a written assessment report with prioritised recommendations and a remediation roadmap for management. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: Housekeeping Standards Audit for Offshore Staff Accommodation
short_description: We operate crew accommodation blocks on Jurong Island for around 180 offshore personnel, and we need an independent review of our housekeeping operations. The work: walk through all rooms, common areas, laundry and waste handling, assess cleaning regimes and chemical use against NEA environmental cleanliness and MOM dormitory requirements, then sit down with our facilities lead to prioritise fixes. Mixed mode, roughly two site visits a week plus advisory calls. Deliverable: a written housekeeping assessment with findings, risk ratings and a prioritised remediation plan. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Proofread and Edit Quality Manual
short_description: We are a mid-sized pharmaceutical contract manufacturer in Tuas, with about 120 staff operating under HSA GDPMD licence. We need a copy-editor to proofread our 180-page quality manual and 14 supporting SOPs before a regulatory submission. Fix grammar, consistency, numbering and cross-references, and flag any statements that could read as non-compliant. Deliverable: marked-up manual and SOPs in tracked changes, plus a short list of flagged issues. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Customer Contact List Clean-Up and Dedupe
short_description: I run a harbour cruise operation in Singapore and our customer list has grown messy. I need someone to tidy up around 4,000 customer records in our bookings spreadsheet: remove duplicates, standardise phone numbers and email formats, flag obvious errors, and fill gaps where consent records under the PDPA are unclear. You would also brief me briefly on keeping the list clean going forward. Deliverable: one cleaned, deduplicated customer list in Excel with a short data issues log. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Redesign of Clinical Training Slide Deck
short_description: We are a mid-sized group of GP clinics in Singapore with about 40 staff across six clinics. We need a specialist to audit the deck, cut it down, rebuild the layout and visual style, and advise our admin team on keeping it usable afterwards. You would also brief two staff on simple maintenance. Deliverable: a redesigned master deck with clean templates and a short style guide. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget around S$4,000-6,000, and we would like work to start by early next month.

gig_title: Auxiliary Police Deployment Review for Cash Operations
short_description: We are a mid-sized Singapore payments firm licensed by MAS, moving roughly S$4-6 million in cash daily across 12 retail agent locations under armed auxiliary police escort. We need a specialist to review our current escort arrangements, deployment schedules and incident response protocols against Police Licensing and Regulatory Department requirements and industry practice. Deliverable: a written assessment with prioritised recommendations on coverage, cost efficiency and compliance gaps. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: ISO 9001 Gap Review for Precision Machining Client
short_description: We run a 20-person engineering consultancy and need our precision machining supplier workstream brought in line with ISO 9001 before an upcoming client audit. We need a quality management specialist to review our supplier qualification process, map it against ISO 9001:2015 clauses, and identify the gaps that need fixing. That includes checking our inspection records, supplier scorecards, and document controls across roughly 12 active suppliers. You will draft the corrective actions and rework two key procedures yourself. Deliverable: a gap assessment report plus two revised procedures, ready for management sign-off. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Copy-Edit Carbon Credit Due Diligence Report
short_description: We are a Singapore freight forwarding and warehousing company, around 60 staff, building a carbon credit brokerage desk. We need a copy-editor to polish a 45-page due diligence report on a basket of voluntary carbon credit products, for circulation to prospective buyers. The work covers consistency checks, terminology against MAS disclosure guidance, clarity of the risk sections, and a light advisory pass on structure and phrasing. Deliverable: an edited manuscript with tracked changes plus a short editorial memo flagging any ambiguous or unsupported claims. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Review of Day Activity Care Programme Manual
short_description: We are a voluntary welfare organisation running a day activity centre for adults with disabilities, serving about 90 clients daily. Our programme manual needs a formal review against current MSF service standards and SG Enable guidelines before an upcoming compliance audit. The work: read the full manual, flag gaps, and redraft the care and activity sections, including client assessment and escalation procedures. Deliverable: an updated programme manual ready for audit submission. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Farm Sourcing Review for Restaurant Group
short_description: We run three restaurants and a central kitchen in Singapore, serving about 4,000 covers a week. We want a specialist in agriculture and agrifood supply to review our fresh produce sourcing, which currently comes from five local farms and two importers. The work is to assess farm practices, traceability and consistency against SFA requirements, then recommend two or three alternative suppliers or direct arrangements. Deliverable: a short written assessment with sourcing recommendations and a switching roadmap. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget is S$4,000-6,000, with work starting by early next month.

gig_title: Maintenance Schedule Setup for Charity Van Fleet
short_description: We are a community care charity running a fleet of 6 vans and 2 minibuses for elder day-care trips across Singapore. We need someone to map out how we track vehicle usage, service dates and LTA road tax renewals, then set up a simple schedule (a working spreadsheet or Fleetio setup) our drivers and admin can follow. Deliverable: a completed maintenance and renewal tracker for all 8 vehicles, with a one-page how-to guide. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Halal-Certified Pastry Recipes for Staff Canteen
short_description: We are a mid-sized building and fit-out contractor running a staff canteen at one of our project sites, serving around 250 workers daily. We want a pastry and baking specialist to review our canteen's existing kueh and pastry items and adapt the recipes to meet SFA food safety requirements and halal-friendly preparation. The work involves spending time in the canteen kitchen, mapping the current baking process, adjusting recipes for larger batch sizes, and advising our cook on ingredient sourcing and storage. Deliverable: a recipe and process file covering 8-10 pastry items, with batch quantities, costing per serving and a one-page food safety checklist. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$3,500-5,000, with work to start in early June.

gig_title: Game Economy Balance Review for Mobile Title
short_description: We run a Singapore-based SaaS platform with a side mobile game studio of six staff. We need a game design specialist to review the economy of our live puzzle title: progression pacing, soft and hard currency sinks, IAP price points and gacha drop rates. Flag where players can grind past paying or hit paywalls too early, and benchmark against comparable titles in the region. Advise on rebalancing options that protect current payer conversion. Deliverable: a written assessment with prioritised tuning recommendations and a numeric model of the adjusted economy. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Project Financing Dashboard Review and Build
short_description: We are a mid-sized engineering consultancy in Singapore, about 60 staff, providing design and inspection services to construction clients. We run several project financing arrangements across our contracts and currently track them in scattered Excel files, which makes board reporting slow and error-prone. We want an independent specialist to review how we structure and report this financing data, advise on the right measures for management, and build a working Power BI or Excel dashboard against our existing files. Deliverable: a working dashboard plus a short written recommendation on data structure and reporting measures. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Investment Policy Statement for Family Wealth
short_description: I run a mid-sized retail business with three outlets, and our family wants to formalise how our private wealth is invested. I need someone from a family office or private wealth background to draft an investment policy statement covering objectives, asset allocation ranges, risk limits and governance for our investment committee. MAS regulatory context should be reflected where relevant. Deliverable: a signed-off investment policy statement, reviewed once with our family council. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.

gig_title: Retail Store Inventory Process Mapping

We want someone to map our current retail stocktaking and replenishment process, advise where it breaks down, and recommend a simple inventory method we can run with two part-time staff. Deliverable: a written process map with recommended standard operating procedure and a basic stock count template. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Valuation of Freight Trucking Business
short_description: I run a small freight and trucking company in Singapore with 25 trucks and 40 staff. I need a valuation of the business prepared for internal planning purposes, covering both assets and earnings. Work involves reviewing our last two years of financials, adjusting for owner-related items, and applying standard valuation methods under prevailing IRAS and IFRS guidance. Deliverable: a written valuation report with workings, assumptions and a defensible value range in S$. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Chinese Translation of Soil Remediation Closure Report
short_description: We are a statutory board overseeing the treatment and disposal of industrial waste in Singapore. We need an English-to-Chinese translator for a soil remediation closure report (about 40 pages, 15,000 words) that will be tabled to counterparts at a regional environmental agency. The language is technical: contaminant names, treatment methods, NEA regulatory terms, sampling results. We need someone who can advise on terminology choices, not just translate, and flag any passages where the Chinese rendering could change the regulatory meaning. Accuracy matters more than speed here. Deliverable: a final translated report in Word, plus a bilingual glossary of key terms with brief notes on judgement calls. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: BCA Compliance Review for New Clinic Fit-Out
short_description: We need an independent review of our clinic's build-in compliance before we hand over to the interior contractor. We are a private medical group running four GP clinics; this one is a new fit-out of about 1,400 sqft in a commercial building. Review the submission drawings against BCA requirements, including the accessibility code and fire safety provisions, and flag anything that will come back as a remark at permit stage. One site walk during the works would be useful. Deliverable: a written compliance assessment with a prioritised list of issues and recommended fixes, sent within a week of site access. Engagement duration: 1-2 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$4,000-6,000; must be able to start by mid-next month.

gig_title: Marine Insurance Compliance Gap Review for Fleet Tender
short_description: We need a compliance review of marine and offshore insurance requirements before we tender for a shipyard construction project. We are a mid-sized civil construction contractor with a small marine works division, and no in-house expertise here. The specialist should map our current cover and site practices against WSH (Shipbuilding and Ship-repairing) Regulations and the insurer's requirements, flag gaps, and advise management on fixes. Deliverable: a written gap report with a prioritised remediation list and a short advisory briefing. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: Review of Student Enrolment Marketing Content
short_description: We run a small private education provider in Singapore with about 20 staff and three part-time diploma programmes. Our enrolment enquiries have been flat this year and we suspect our marketing content is not reaching working adults. We want someone to review our current channels: our website copy, two social media pages and the monthly email newsletter we send to roughly 1,200 past students. Assess what is working, where the gaps are and how we should prioritise. Please check our messaging also meets CPE guidelines on course advertising. Deliverable: a written assessment with prioritised recommendations and a simple content plan we can run ourselves. Engagement duration: 2 weeks.

gig_title: WSH Incident Investigation Report for Law Firm Office

We are a 40-person law firm with no in-house WSH capability. Deliverable: a complete incident investigation report suitable for submission to MOM, with corrective action plan. gig_title: Medical Equipment Maintenance Audit for Nursing Home
short_description: We run a 90-bed nursing home in Singapore and need a specialist to audit our medical equipment maintenance programme. You will also brief our ops team on setting up a workable preventive maintenance schedule. Deliverable: an audit report with a risk-rated equipment register, compliance gap findings and a proposed maintenance schedule. Engagement duration: 4 weeks.

gig_title: Import Pricing and Margin Review
short_description: We run a small chain of three cafes and a central kitchen in Singapore, importing most of our coffee, dairy and pastry ingredients. We want an independent specialist to review our import and trading practices: assess current supplier pricing structures, landed costs, customs and GST treatment under Singapore rules, and how our menu prices flow through. Advise management on where margin is leaking and what to change. Deliverable: a written assessment with costed recommendations and a prioritised action roadmap, presented to our directors. Engagement duration: 6-8 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$12,000-16,000, available to start within two weeks.

gig_title: Clear Backlog of Customer Legal Correspondence
short_description: We need a backlog of customer legal correspondence cleared for a small beauty and wellness retail chain with three outlets. You would read and triage each item, draft standard responses using our templates, flag the handful that need escalation to our director, and log everything in a simple tracker. Deliverable: a cleared inbox with drafted replies ready to send, an escalation list, and an up-to-date tracking spreadsheet. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$4,000-6,000, must be able to start within two weeks.

gig_title: Marine Casualty Opinion for Hull Claim Dispute
short_description: I run the marine claims team at a Singapore-based insurer writing hull and machinery cover for regional vessel owners. You would also walk our claims committee through your reasoning and answer follow-up questions during settlement talks. Deliverable: a written opinion report, roughly 20-30 pages, suitable for reliance in a potential MAS-supervised dispute process. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
additional_notes: Budget S$18,000-25,000; must be available to start within two weeks.

gig_title: Independent Review of HAZOP Study for Petrochemical Client
short_description: We are an engineering consultancy in Singapore supporting a petrochemical facility under SCDF and MOM requirements, and we need an independent third-party review of a completed HAZOP study for one of their process units before it goes to the regulator. Review the HAZOP worksheets, node definitions, risk ranking and recommended actions, check the methodology against IEC 61882, and flag any gaps in scenario coverage, safeguards or action close-out. Attend one half-day session with our team to walk through your findings. Deliverable: a written independent review report with findings, severity assessment and specific recommendations for revision, suitable for submission to the regulator. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: Tree Risk Assessment Advice for Office Campus

NParks guidelines and relevant SS standards should frame the recommendations. Work involves a site walkover, visual tree assessment of each tree, photo records, and a priority ranking with rough cost indications for follow-up works. Deliverable: a written tree risk assessment report with a tree-by-tree schedule, risk ratings and recommended actions per tree. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.

gig_title: Salary Benchmarking Review for 40-Person Consultancy
short_description: We are a 40-person audit and advisory firm in Singapore reviewing our pay structure ahead of our annual review cycle. You will pull comparable data, account for our T-shaped progression bands, and flag where we are off market. Deliverable: a benchmarking report with adjusted salary ranges per role and a summary memo for our partners. Engagement duration: 2-3 weeks.

gig_title: SFA Compliance Review for New Snack Line

The canteen operates 6 outlets serving roughly 4,000 meals daily, so volumes are real and the stakes are compliance, not theory. You will advise as you review, flagging what must change and what is fine. Deliverable: a written review with findings, shelf-life recommendation and prioritised corrective actions. Engagement duration: 3-4 weeks.

gig_title: School Bus Route Optimisation and Tender Specification

We need someone to analyse existing routes and ridership data, redesign the route structure for the next school year, and prepare a tender-ready service specification that meets LTA and MOM requirements for student transport. You will work with our operations staff to validate the new routes and flag cost implications. Deliverable: a revised route plan with per-route ridership and cost estimates, plus a complete tender specification document for bus operators. Engagement duration: 4-6 weeks.
